episodes.synopsis: When Takamachi Nanoha, a 3rd grader elementary school girl, finds a wounded ferret and takes care of it she finds out she has magical powers and helps it fight a monster that attacked it.
episodes.title: That's a mysterious meeting, is it not?

episodes.synopsis: After Nanoha transformed into a magical girl she and Yuuno fight the Jewel Seed and win. Yuuno tells Nanoha about him, the Jewel Seeds and her new magical powers when a new Jewel Seed appears and they go fight it.
episodes.title: The charm is 'lyrical'?

episodes.synopsis: Nanoha is exhausted from living her life as a normal girl during the day, and her magical girl life at night, but she has managed to get five Jewel Seeds. When a boy on her father's soccer team activates a Jewel Seed, it is up to Nanoha to save the town.
episodes.title: The Town's in a Lot of Danger?

episodes.synopsis: Suzaka invites Nanoha and Arisa over for a tea party. However, it is interupted for Nanoha when a jewel seed is activated. A mysterious black mage girl comes to claim the Jewel Seed, is she friend or foe?
episodes.title: A Rival!? Another Magical Girl!

episodes.synopsis: Fate and her familiar Arf challenge Nanoha at a hot spring.
episodes.title: This is a Town of Hot Water, and the Ocean's Roar Hot Springs!

episodes.synopsis: Arisa suspects that Nanoha is hiding something.
episodes.title: Feelings That Can't Be Understood

episodes.synopsis: Fate's mother, the real villain, is revealed just as the Time-Space Administration Bureau arrives.
episodes.title: The Third Mage!?

episodes.synopsis: Nanoha joins with the Time-Space Administration Bureau. Yūno reveals his human form to Nanoha.
episodes.title: There's A Really Big Crisis?

episodes.synopsis: Nanoha ignores orders and tries to help Fate.
episodes.title: The Decisive Battle Above the Ocean!

episodes.synopsis: Arf is thrown out by Precia and joins Nanoha. Nanoha visits her friends and family, and sorts everything out.
episodes.title: Everybody's Seperate Heart-felt Vows

episodes.synopsis: Nanoha and Fate battle for all the Jewel Seeds, and Fate's origin is revealed.
episodes.title: Memories That Lie Beyond Time

episodes.synopsis: In the final battle, the TSAB march on the Garden of Time.
episodes.title: The Time of the Sealing of Our Fates

episodes.synopsis: Nanoha and Yūno say their farewells to the TSAB and they both head home.
episodes.title: Call My Name
